answer: Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, converted to a slow vesting stream, rewards vest against future work. Work waits on the ferrous until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the cipher of the next round. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the onyx of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
